title: PhysxSurfaceDeformableMaterialAPI
summary: PhysX bend damping for a surface deformable material, read only when the material prim also carries OmniPhysicsSurfaceDeformableMaterialAPI and lists PhysxSurfaceDeformableMaterialAPI in its usd-schemas.
producer_scope: Published like any applied physics API: every declared attribute at its resolved value. USD population also lists the built-in PhysxDeformableMaterialAPI in usd-schemas. No column is rewritten or created by the producer.

columns.name: physxDeformableMaterial:bendDamping
columns.absent: 0: no bend damping. A negative value is clamped to 0 at parse.
columns.notes: The property update applies a change to a surface material only, without the clamp.

interactions.rule: Read only when that API is listed on the same prim: it decides whether the material is parsed as a surface material at all.
elasticityDamping lives on the built-in PhysxDeformableMaterialAPI, which the parser checks separately.
